package.name: wheel_odometry
package.description: Mecanum-drive wheel odometry for the Lynxmotion A4WD3 Mecanum rover, driven by two RoboClaw motor controllers (one per side). Reads all four quadrature encoders over the RoboClaw packet-serial protocol, applies mecanum forward kinematics, integrates a planar pose, and publishes nav_msgs/Odometry (+ TF) for use in sensor fusion.
